- **New first launch and sign-in.** Full-screen pages instead of pop-up dialogs:
  one server address field, then Quick Connect and username/password side by side.
- **Quick Connect** shows its code straight away and replaces it by itself when it
  expires. A wrong password no longer stops the code from working.
- **Stays signed in.** A server that can't be reached at launch no longer sends you
  back to sign-in; SlopFin retries, then offers Continue with your sign-in kept.
- **Updates from GitHub work again** on consoles that did not trust GitHub's current
  certificates, and saved data is recovered before the account loads (from 1.13).
- **Dashboard → Activity** can show one person's activity, or everyone's.
- **Settings → Discover** has a clear connection status and a single Connect or
  Disconnect action; the overlapping status text is fixed.
- A new loading screen with the SlopFin mark and a spinner.

**Sign-in** pages: confirming the server address on the keyboard connects; on the
sign-in page, confirming the password signs in and Triangle shows it. Circle goes
back to the server address. Only a server that rejects the saved sign-in asks you
to sign in again; a slow network or a restarting server keeps it.

**Updates and storage** (carried from 1.13): the app bundles current public CA
certificates for GitHub's release API and downloads and for Jellyfin HTTPS, with
verification still on. Certificate failures are reported separately from a missing
connection. If saved data can't be opened at launch, SlopFin shows a retry screen
instead of starting sign-in with empty settings.

An installed 1.12 or older cannot pick up the certificate fix through its own
updater. If **Settings → Updates** can't reach GitHub, install the complete
**folder ZIP** below once. Keep `/data/slopfin/config.json` to preserve your
sign-in and preferences.

The new screens, session handling and Dashboard filter pass host tests and Linux
preview checks against a stand-in server. The 1.13 transport and storage fixes
were verified on firmware 8.20. The 1.14 interface has not yet been run on a console.

Update in **Settings → Updates**, or install the complete **folder ZIP** below.
Sign-in and preferences are preserved. [Update guide](https://github.com/BeLikeBrett/SlopFin/blob/main/docs/UPDATES.md).
